others.route: Business Purpose Visa (art, music and dance events)

note: Sri Lanka: taking part in art, music and dance events is an allowed activity of the Business Purpose Visa, on an invitation letter from the relevant institution, which allows no employment, paid or unpaid; the tourist visa allows no performing. Employment by a Sri Lankan employer, under a residence visa, isn't modelled apart. No days without a visa.

sources.title: Department of Immigration and Emigration (Sri Lanka), Business Purpose Visa
sources.said: A Business Purpose Visa is issued to foreign nationals who visit Sri Lanka for business purposes for short period of time. ... Participate in art, music and dance events ... Engage in employment paid/unpaid, self –employment ... Invitation/ Request letter from relevant institutions
